description: Prepare negative keywords for a client's Google Ads: a shared list on the named campaigns, or on every enabled Search, Shopping and Display campaign. Nothing is left behind if it attaches nowhere. Changes nothing: returns a preview_id (15 min, one use) for execute_prepared_change.

campaign_ids.description: ADS Beast ids of the Google campaigns to attach the list to; omit for every enabled Search, Shopping and Display campaign.

keywords.description: Negative keywords to add, one phrase per item, at most 50 (the executor's cap).

list_name.description: Name of the shared negative list; a dated name is used by default.

reason.description: Why, with numbers (shown to the approver).

name: prepare_negative_keywords_add
